tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Search the UK stores Vouchernaut lists by name or category ("flowers", "Currys", "phone cases"). Each store comes with how many live codes and deals it has, its best few offers with tracked links (each code itself only where the brand has approved AI assistants, else its vouchernaut.com page), a link to shop there and its vouchernaut.com page.

query.description: A store name or what's being bought

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.description: Every live discount code and deal Vouchernaut lists for one UK store, in the order its store page shows them: what each saves, its terms and end date, how many shoppers said it worked or failed, and a link that opens the store with the offer. A code itself comes only where the brand has approved AI assistants; any other comes without it (`code_on_page`), linking to the store's vouchernaut.com page, where the shopper reveals it. The store can be named ("Arena Flowers"), or given by its slug or its vouchernaut.com page. Each link may earn Vouchernaut a commission, which every result discloses.

store.description: The store's name, slug or vouchernaut.com store page URL

kind.description: Only codes, only deals, or both

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the products UK stores sell through Vouchernaut (flowers, gifts, hampers, candles, homeware and more): title, store, price, the price after the store's best discount code, honest price-history notes ("Down from", "Lowest in 90 days"), the same product at other stores, and a tracked link to buy. Each product has a `ref` ("<store>/<product>").

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "red roses", "birthday hamper"

max_price.description: Most it should cost, in pounds

min_price.description: Least it should cost, in pounds

type.description: A product type, e.g. flowers, plants, chocolate, food, drinks, candles, beauty, jewellery, cards, balloons, toys, home; children with a dot ("flowers.dried")

on_sale.description: Only products below the store's full price

sort.description: Order: best match (default), cheapest, dearest, newest or biggest price drop

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product, by its `ref` ("<store>/<product>") or its vouchernaut.com page: every variant's price and stock, the store's best discount code that covers it and the price after it (the code itself only where the brand has approved AI assistants, else the saving and the store page that reveals it), its price history (lowest, typical, now), delivery, the same product at other stores and a tracked link to buy.

product.description: The product's ref ("candles-direct/sandalwood-rose") or its page URL

tools.name: price_drops
tools.description: Products across UK stores whose price fell in the last 30 days from a price the store had held for at least 28 days, biggest fall first. Each comes with the old and new price and a tracked link. Narrow by search words, product type, store or price.

max_price.description: Most it should cost, in pounds

min_price.description: Least it should cost, in pounds

type.description: A product type, e.g. flowers, plants, chocolate, food, drinks, candles, beauty, jewellery, cards, balloons, toys, home; children with a dot ("flowers.dried")

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description: Whether a product's price at a UK shop is a real deal, from Vouchernaut's own record of that shop's prices: pass a product page link from the shop, a barcode, a product's name or a `ref` ("<store>/<product>"). Gives the verdict on today's price (lowest we've recorded, no change, cheaper before and when), the shops selling the same product for less today, and a tracked link to buy. Says plainly when the shop isn't one whose prices are tracked. Never uses shops' own "was" prices or RRPs.

query.description: A product link from the shop, a barcode (8 to 14 digits), a product name ("dairy milk 200g") or a ref

tools.name: game_prices
tools.description: Every shop's price for a video game on Vouchernaut (UK accounts): official stores (Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox, Nintendo eShop and the like) first, then key shops, for one platform and edition. Each price includes the fee the shop's feed gives, says key or download and its region, and warns where a key may not work on a UK account; each has a tracked link to the shop. A shop's discount code is never given, only its price with the code and the page that shows it.

game.description: The game, by name ("Elden Ring"), slug or vouchernaut.com/games page address

platform.description: A platform it's sold for ("PlayStation", "Steam", "Xbox", "Nintendo"); the first listed if left out

edition.description: An edition ("Deluxe"); the standard one if left out

key_shops.description: Include key resellers and marketplaces (on by default)

limit.description: Shops to return, in the page's order

tools.name: gift_card_prices
tools.description: Prices for PlayStation Store (PSN), Xbox and Nintendo eShop gift cards and for PS Plus, Xbox Game Pass and Nintendo Switch Online membership codes, for UK or US accounts, at the shops Vouchernaut checks. Name one card ("£20 PSN card", "Game Pass Ultimate 3 months") for every shop's price for it, beside the platform's own price; name a group ("PSN gift cards", "PS Plus", "Game Pass") for every value or membership in it, each at its cheapest shop. Prices include the fee each shop's feed gives; each has a tracked link to the shop.

card.description: A card, a membership or a group: "£50 PSN card", "PS Plus Extra 12 months", "PSN gift cards", "Nintendo eShop", or a vouchernaut.com/games/cards page address

market.description: UK (gb, the default) or US accounts

limit.description: Shops to return for one card, in the page's order; a group lists every card

tools.name: find_phone_deals
tools.description: Every deal UK retailers list for one phone on Vouchernaut's phone finder: monthly price with its upfront cost, contract length, total cost over the contract with announced price rises included (and each rise in pounds and month), data, network and seller, with a tracked link to the retailer. Filter by storage, colour, condition, budget, network, contract length and data.

colour.description: Colour as the retailers name it

network.description: Only plans on this network (brands on it, like iD Mobile on Three, count)

max_monthly.description: Most a month, in whole pounds

months.description: Contract length in months (1 is monthly rolling)

min_data.description: At least this many GB a month, or unlimited

upgrade.description: Deals for customers already on the network

sort.description: Lowest total cost (default), lowest monthly, lowest upfront, or most data

tools.name: sim_only_deals
tools.description: SIM-only plans UK retailers list on Vouchernaut: monthly price with upfront cost, contract length, total cost with announced price rises included, data, network and seller, with a tracked link. Filter by data, budget, network and contract length. Unlimited data is subject to fair use.

network.description: Only plans on this network (brands on it, like iD Mobile on Three, count)

max_monthly.description: Most a month, in whole pounds

months.description: Contract length in months (1 is monthly rolling)

min_data.description: At least this many GB a month, or unlimited

upgrade.description: Deals for customers already on the network

sort.description: Lowest total cost (default), lowest monthly, lowest upfront, or most data

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Gigs, comedy, theatre, festivals, exhibitions and things to do in about 90 UK places, from ticket and experience sellers: title, date and time, venue and address, the lowest price where the seller's price includes its fees, and a tracked link to buy tickets. Filter by when, a date, category or words.

city.description: A UK town or city, e.g. "Manchester"

when.description: today, tomorrow, weekend, week (next 7 days) or month (next 30)

query.description: An artist, show or words to match

things_to_do.description: Experiences and attractions open any day, rather than dated events

tools.name: airport_parking
tools.description: Car parks UK parking providers sell at the UK's main airports: meet and greet, park and ride and on-airport, with transfer times, terminals, Safer Parking status, compulsory charges on the day and, for given drop-off and pick-up times, the full price including known fees, with a tracked link to book. Prices are only for a stay given by `from` and `to`.

airport.description: Airport name or IATA code, e.g. "Gatwick", "MAN"

type.description: Only this kind of car park

tools.name: get_poll_result
tools.description: Results of Vouchernaut's reader polls (UK shoppers answering short questions in its guides): the question, each answer's votes and share, and the poll's page to cite. Shares are quotable ("one in three readers") only once a poll has 100 answers. Without `poll`, it lists the polls.

poll.description: The poll's slug, from the list

tools.name: find_software
tools.description: Software and AI tools Vouchernaut covers (AI assistants, meeting notes, dictation, website builders, email marketing and more): price, free plan, trial, platforms, review scores and any live deal, with each tool's vouchernaut.com page. Each tool's slug is also its store's slug. Without `category`, it covers every category and lists them.

category.description: A category slug from the list, e.g. "ai-assistants"

query.description: Words to match in the name or tagline

tools.name: calculate_take_home_pay
tools.description: What a UK employee's pay comes to after income tax, National Insurance (category A), student loan and a workplace pension, for the current tax year, by the year, month and week, with each tax band, the sources and a link to the worked answer on vouchernaut.com. Worked on the year as a whole, as HMRC's rates are; a payslip works each pay period on its own, so it can be a few pounds a year different. Covers England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland and everyday tax codes, not K codes, benefits in kind, other income or the self-employed. Information, not financial advice.

salary.description: Pay before anything comes off, in pounds, for the `per` period

hours_per_week.description: Hours worked a week, for an hourly rate

region.description: Where the employee lives for tax: Scotland sets its own bands

tax_code.description: Their tax code, e.g. "1257L", "S1257L", "BR"; leave out for the standard one

pension.description: Workplace pension: net pay (taken before tax), ras (relief at source: taken after tax, basic rate relief added) or sacrifice (salary sacrifice)

pension_percent.description: The employee's contribution as a percent of pay

pension_monthly.description: Or the contribution in pounds a month

pension_on_qualifying_earnings.description: Whether the percent is of qualifying earnings (the auto-enrolment band) rather than all pay

student_loans.description: Student loan plans repaid through pay: plan1 (England or Wales before September 2012, and Northern Ireland), plan2 (England from September 2012 to July 2023, and Wales from September 2012), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (England from August 2023), postgrad (master's or doctoral loans in England or Wales)

tools.name: student_loan_repayments
tools.description: What a UK student loan costs a month now, and whether it's cleared or written off first: a month-by-month projection to the plan's write-off on stated assumptions (pay rises and RPI, which the caller may change), with this year's threshold and interest rate, the total repaid and the sources. A projection, not a forecast, and information, not financial advice: it never says whether to pay a loan off early.

plan.description: plan1 (England or Wales before September 2012, and Northern Ireland), plan2 (England from September 2012 to July 2023, and Wales from September 2012), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (England from August 2023), postgrad (master's or doctoral loans in England or Wales)

salary.description: Pay before tax for a year, in pounds

first_due_year.description: The year of the April repayments were first due: the April after leaving the course

rpi_percent.description: Assumed RPI a year, after this year's published rates

extra_monthly.description: Paid on top each month, in pounds

tools.name: check_refund_rights
tools.description: The UK consumer rights that apply to something bought (faulty, not arrived, poor service or a change of mind), strongest first, each with its last day as a date and the law it comes from (Consumer Rights Act 2015, Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013), then what the way it was paid adds (section 75, chargeback, PayPal, buy now pay later) and where to go next. Legal information, not legal advice: it never decides a claim.

bought.description: Online (or by phone or post), in a shop, or at the door or away from a shop

kind.description: Something physical, a download or app, or a service

problem.description: What went wrong, by kind: faulty, not-arrived, changed-mind (goods); faulty, changed-mind (digital); poor-service, changed-mind (service). faulty covers not as described

ordered_on.description: The day it was bought or ordered, YYYY-MM-DD

arrived_on.description: The day it was delivered (goods bought online or at the door), or the day it was marked delivered when it hasn't arrived. Leave out for a shop purchase

price.description: The price of the one item, in pounds

paid.description: Credit card, debit card, buy now pay later, PayPal, or cash or another way

nation.description: Where the buyer lives: it sets the time limits and where to go next

exceptions.description: For a change of mind, what may take away the 14 days: personalised, perishable, unsealed-hygiene, unsealed-media (goods); download-started (digital); dated-booking (service)

agreed_delivery_on.description: Not arrived: the delivery day agreed with the seller, YYYY-MM-DD

delivery_essential.description: Not arrived: the buyer told the seller the date was essential

left_where_asked.description: Marked delivered: the courier left it with someone or somewhere the buyer chose

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Vouchernaut, a UK shopping guide: stores with discount codes, products and their prices, phones on its phone finder, and its buying guides. Each result has an id, a title and its page's URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one result from search: a store's live codes and deals with their links, a product's price and code (a code itself only where the brand has approved AI assistants, else the store's vouchernaut.com page), a phone's deals, or a buying guide.
